issues.concern: The English translation 'I can't think straight' for '頭が回らない' is a good idiomatic equivalent, but the literal translation 'My head isn't spinning' or 'My brain isn't working' would be more helpful for an intermediate learner to understand the nuance of '回る' in this context, especially since the previous example (7) uses a literal translation for '目が回る'. The current translation loses the connection to the headword's core meaning.
issues.suggestion: I drank too much coffee and my head isn't working. I'm tired from not being able to sleep. (Lit: My head isn't spinning.)
